meta.title: chronicle as a Claude Code plugin
meta.description: The plugins/chronicle directory and what each file becomes in a Claude Code session: a plugin name, two skills, a subagent and a builder.

theme.concept: A painter's drafting table: graphite ink on cool cold-pressed paper, ultramarine for the work chronicle does, yellow ochre for the old manual path, from the plugin's own pipeline where pencil SVG becomes watercolor.

steps.caption: A plugin is one directory; chronicle's manifest gives it its name and version.
Two SKILL.md files become two commands that Claude also loads when a request fits.
The agent file becomes a subagent that gathers facts read-only, in its own context.
The Python builder ships in the same folder, and the skills run it through Bash.
